title: The image with stricter verdict lines
tested: Whether a synthetic job still succeeds on the dispatch image from #202.
changed: The dispatch image from [#202](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/pull/202): stricter verdict lines, answers Argo can pass on, and no call counts for a job that did not complete. The job program fails a job offered a tool beyond the recipe's and `load_skill`.
setup: The fixture question: is finding F-0001 confirmed, with its evidence under `ev-0001`
source: Live system, 2026-10-25 21:49 UTC. Each workflow as Argo kept it, read at 05:32 UTC the next day, the worker's job lines, and the tool service's audit lines.

jobs.answer:

Status: confirmed
